login.heading: Log in to Trilium Notes
login.incorrect-password: Password is incorrect. Please try again.
login.incorrect-totp: One-time password is incorrect. Please try again.
login.incorrect-recovery-code: Recovery code is incorrect, or has already been used.
login.too-many-attempts: Too many login attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
login.connection-error: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
login.sso-wrong-account: That account isn't the one linked to this Trilium instance. Sign in with the linked account.
login.sso-not-enrolled: Single sign-on isn't set up yet. Sign in with your password first, then link your account from the settings.
login.sso-connection-failed: Couldn't reach the authentication provider. Try again, or check the server logs for details.

set_password.heading: Set password
set_password.description: Before you can start using Trilium from web, you need to set a password first. You will then use this password to login.
set_password.password-too-short: Password must be at least {{length}} characters long.

setup.heading: Get started with Trilium
setup.new-document-description: Start with a clean knowledge base and begin right away.
setup.sync-from-desktop-description: You only have a Trilium desktop app running on another device. This device will sync its data from that desktop app.
setup.sync-from-server-description: You have a Trilium server running elsewhere (either self-hosted or in the cloud). This device will sync its data from that server.
setup.redirecting: You will be shortly redirected to the application.
setup.title: Setup
setup.sync-from-server-page-description: Enter your server details below to connect your existing workspace.
setup.sync-in-progress-description: Your device is now connected and items are being synchronized.
setup.sync-in-progress-banner: This may take a while depending on the size of your notes. Please do not switch to another application until the sync is complete.
setup.create-new-document-options-title: How would you like to start?
setup.create-new-document-options-empty-descri: Start with a blank knowledge base. You can import demo notes later.
setup.create-new-document-description: This will only take a moment.
setup.create-new-document-failed: Your knowledge base could not be created
setup.sync-from-desktop-step1: Open your desktop instance of Trilium Notes.
setup.sync-from-desktop-step2: From the Trilium Menu, click Options.
setup.sync-from-desktop-step3: Click on Sync category in the note tree.
setup.sync-from-desktop-step4: Change server instance address to point to one of the addresses on the right (or below, on a narrow screen) and click Save.
setup.sync-from-desktop-step5: Click the "Test sync" button to verify connection is successful.
setup.sync-from-desktop-warning: Make sure both devices are on the same network.
setup.sync-from-desktop-unreachable-title: This device can't be reached by other devices
setup.sync-from-desktop-unreachable-descriptio: To sync, the other desktop has to connect to this one over the network. For security, this desktop app only accepts connections from this computer, so that other desktop can't reach it yet. Allow network access below — Trilium will restart to apply it.
setup.sync-failed-description: The initial synchronization could not be completed. You can retry, or go back to check the server address and credentials.
setup.sync-failed-hint: This can be caused by a wrong server address, a proxy interfering with the connection, or the server being temporarily unreachable.
setup.proxy-instruction: If you leave proxy setting blank, system proxy will be used.
setup.existing-data-skip-warning: Nothing is deleted yet. Your knowledge base is only replaced once you choose to create a new one, restore a backup or sync from another device.
setup.existing-data-backed-up-description: Your existing knowledge base has been saved to a backup file.
setup.existing-data-backup-failed: The backup could not be created.
setup.backup-name-description: Give this backup a name you will recognise later, or keep the suggested one.
setup.backup-password-description: If you specify a password, the backup file will be encrypted. Keep the password somewhere safe: without it, the backup cannot be restored.
setup.backup-use-stored-password: Use the password you already configured
setup.backup-use-stored-password-description: Use the same encryption password you have previously set up in Options → Backup.
setup.backup-compress-description: Makes the file smaller, at the cost of some time while it is written.
setup.backup-data-description: In the Standalone version of Trilium Notes, backups are generated on the spot and downloaded directly to your device. They are not stored anywhere else, so make sure you save the file.
setup.backup-do-not-close: Please do not switch away or close this screen until the download completes.
setup.backup-downloaded: The download has completed. Press "Finish" to return to the application.
setup.existing-data-erase-confirm: Your existing knowledge base will now be permanently deleted, so that this device can receive one from your desktop app. Make sure you have a backup somewhere safe. Continue?
setup.unlock-refused: Those details were not accepted. Please try again.
setup.keep-existing-description: Keep using your existing knowledge base and go back to the app.
setup.existing-data-keep-failed: The existing knowledge base could not be reopened.
setup.restore-from-backup-description: Start using a knowledge base restored from a backup file.
setup.restore-from-backup-page-description: Choose the backup to restore from.
setup.restore-choose-file-description: Select a database backup file (.db, .tnbackup) from your device
setup.restore-error-too-new: This backup is from a newer version of Trilium. Update Trilium and try again.
setup.restore-error-too-old: This backup is from a version of Trilium that is too old to be restored.
setup.restore-error-unfinished: This backup was taken from a setup that was never finished, so there is nothing in it to restore.
setup.restore-error-swap-failed: The database could not be replaced. Your previous database is back in place.
setup.restore-error-swap-failed-reload: The database could not be replaced. Your previous database is back in place, but Trilium could not reopen it. Reload this page to continue.
setup.restore-error-check-failed: The backup could not be checked. This may be a problem on this device rather than with the backup itself, so it is worth trying again.
setup.restore-error-failed: The restore could not be completed. Nothing was replaced, so your knowledge base is as it was.
setup.restore-error-incomplete: This backup file is incomplete. It was probably not copied or downloaded in full, so try transferring it again.
setup.restore-error-would-not-open: The restored database could not be opened. Your previous database is back in place.
setup.restore-error-refused: Another setup step is already running.
setup.restore-error-already-initialized: This instance already has a knowledge base, so it cannot be restored over. Reload the page.
setup.restore-error-could-not-start: The restore could not be started.
setup.restore-error-upload-failed: The backup could not be uploaded.
setup.restore-error-upload-interrupted: The upload was interrupted and could not be continued. Choose the backup again to start over.
setup.restore-passphrase-description: This backup is encrypted. Enter the password used to create this backup.
setup.restore-wrong-passphrase: That password does not open this backup. Please try again.
